name: siddha-astro-mobile-redesign
description: Siddha Astro mobile-first web app packaged for Android and iOS with Capacitor.

scripts.build:web: mkdir -p www && esbuild panchang-engine-source.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=www/panchang-engine.js && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.json' \) ! -name 'package.json' ! -name 'package-lock.json' ! -name 'panchang-engine-source.js' ! -name 'panchang-engine.js' -exec cp {} www/ \; && cp panchang-engine.js www/panchang-engine.js
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
